words.example: Thursday's staff meeting opens with the KPI review.
words.exampleZh: 周四的员工会从指标回顾开始。

words.example: Training's RAG status went yellow after two classes were postponed.
words.exampleZh: 两门课推迟之后，培训的红黄绿状态变成了黄色。

words.example: Training moved to amber once two classes had to be postponed.
words.exampleZh: 有两门课不得不推迟之后，培训进入了黄色预警。

words.example: Registration went to red status when the calling screen stopped.
words.exampleZh: 叫号屏一停，挂号就进入了红色状态。

words.example: Payroll moved back to green status once the salary file went through.
words.exampleZh: 工资文件一通过，薪酬就回到了绿色正常。

words.example: A kernel panic on the imaging host froze every viewer session in that rack.
words.exampleZh: 影像主机内核崩溃，那个机柜里的阅片会话全部冻住了。

words.example: The kernel wrote an oops to the log just before the archive host hung.
words.exampleZh: 归档主机卡死之前，内核刚在日志里写了一条内核异常。

words.example: The watchdog rebooted the archive host after the kernel stopped answering.
words.exampleZh: 内核不再响应之后，看门狗重启了归档主机。

words.example: Last night kdump captured the crash from the imaging host, so we can see why it panicked.
words.exampleZh: 昨晚的内核转储存下了影像主机的崩溃现场，我们才看得出它为什么崩溃。

words.example: The core pattern points crash dumps at /var/crash, and that disk is almost full.
words.exampleZh: 转储路径指向 /var/crash，那块盘快满了。
